form.label: Copilot AI Credit Billing
form.description: GitHub Copilot AI-credit budget, consumption, model mix, and per-user usage. Gross figures reflect nominal AI-credit consumption; net reflects post-discount billable amount.

search.query: `github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:budget" budget_product_sku="$budgetSku$" | stats latest(budget_amount) as budget_amount by enterprise scope budget_entity_name budget_product_sku | stats sum(budget_amount) as allocation

`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit" | stats sum(grossAmount) as consumed | appendcols [ search `github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:budget" budget_product_sku="$budgetSku$" | stats latest(budget_amount) as budget_amount by enterprise scope budget_entity_name budget_product_sku | stats sum(budget_amount) as allocation ] | eval pct=round((consumed/allocation)*100,1) | fields pct

panel.title: Gross vs net consumption over time (enterprise)

search.query: `github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit" | timechart span=1d sum(grossAmount) as "Gross" sum(netAmount) as "Net (billable)"

`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit" | timechart span=1d sum(grossAmount) as daily | streamstats sum(daily) as cumulative_gross | appendcols [ search `github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:budget" budget_product_sku="$budgetSku$" | stats latest(budget_amount) as budget_amount by enterprise scope budget_entity_name budget_product_sku | stats sum(budget_amount) as allocation | eval _t=1 ] | filldown allocation | fields _time cumulative_gross allocation
`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit" | stats sum(grossQuantity) as credits sum(grossAmount) as gross_amount by model | sort - credits | head 20
`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit" | eval router=if(match(model, "^Auto: "), "Auto", "Explicit") | stats sum(grossAmount) as gross_amount by router
`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit" | stats sum(grossAmount) as gross_amount by sku

`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit_by_user" | stats sum(grossQuantity) as credits sum(grossAmount) as gross_amount dc(model) as models by user | sort - credits | head 25 | rename user as "User" credits as "Credits (gross)" gross_amount as "Gross amount" models as "Distinct models"
`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit_by_user" | timechart span=1d sum(grossAmount) by user limit=10

`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit_by_cost_center" | stats sum(grossQuantity) as credits sum(grossAmount) as gross_amount dc(model) as models by cost_center_name | sort - gross_amount | rename cost_center_name as "Cost center" credits as "Credits (gross)" gross_amount as "Gross amount" models as "Distinct models"

`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit_by_org" | stats sum(grossQuantity) as credits sum(grossAmount) as gross_amount dc(model) as models by organization | sort - gross_amount | rename organization as "Organization" credits as "Credits (gross)" gross_amount as "Gross amount" models as "Distinct models"

`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:budget" | stats latest(budget_amount) as budget_amount latest(prevent_further_usage) as prevent_further_usage latest(effective_consumed_amount) as consumed latest('budget_alerting.will_alert') as will_alert latest('budget_alerting.alert_recipients{}') as alert_recipients by enterprise budget_product_sku budget_scope | eval alert_recipients=mvjoin(alert_recipients, ", ") | eval consumed=if(isnull(consumed),"(not reported)",consumed) | table enterprise budget_product_sku budget_scope budget_amount consumed prevent_further_usage will_alert alert_recipients | rename budget_product_sku as SKU budget_scope as Scope budget_amount as Allocation prevent_further_usage as "Blocks usage" will_alert as "Alerts on" alert_recipients as "Alert recipients"

panel.title: Duplicate daily usage keys (should be empty)

search.query: `github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit" | stats count sum(grossAmount) as gross by enterprise scope date sku model | where count > 1 | sort - count

`github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit" | stats sum(grossAmount) as enterprise_gross by date | append [ search `github_source` sourcetype="github:copilot:billing:ai_credit_by_user" | stats sum(grossAmount) as user_gross by date ] | stats sum(enterprise_gross) as "Enterprise" sum(user_gross) as "Sum of users" by date
